_comment: Schema is a FLAT override of isofit.utils.template_construction.LUTConfig
forward_model config. Grids are built by LUTConfig.get_grid as
AOD is set via aerosol_2_*: with a non-.jld2 emulator (sRTMnet) ISOFIT
copies aerosol_2_* onto aot_550_* and zeroes aerosol_2_spacing, so setting
With --presolve, the presolve grid is fixed at 0.2..max_water
(apply_oe.py:704) and h2o_range is replaced by the 2nd/98th percentile of
the presolve retrieval, floored at h2o_min (apply_oe.py:744-749). Pixels at
or below h2o_min are also dropped from those percentiles, so h2o_min is the
one H2O knob that matters here.
h2o_min lowered 0.5 -> 0.2 (ISOFIT's default and the presolve floor): the
Himalayan scene DT0000187759 (median 4.5 km) retrieved 0.50 cm everywhere,
pinned at the old floor, and ran +0.03 high at 977/1128 nm vs PACO.
AOD ceiling raised 0.40 -> 0.90 (1.1.2 vs PACO, 25N Ganges scene in April):
reflectance ran +0.16 high at 418 nm, fading by 700 nm - the signature of
under-removed aerosol scattering from a retrieval pinned at the ceiling.
